description: Client-side script for rendering and managing the Spark application history page, including data fetching, table configuration, and UI interactions.

methods.name: setAppLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of applications to fetch and display.

methods.name: escapeHtml
methods.description: Escapes special HTML characters to prevent XSS.

methods.name: makeIdNumeric
methods.description: Converts an application ID to a zero-padded numeric string for sorting.

methods.name: getParameterByName
methods.description: Retrieves URL query parameter value by name.

methods.name: removeColumnByName
methods.description: Removes a column from the DataTable configuration by column name.

methods.name: getColumnIndex
methods.description: Gets the index of a column by name.
